sections.translation: ## Recording Screen The **MX2200** console allows for a **safety recording of the event** in **MP3 (16-bit / 48 kHz)** stereo format, widely supported by audio players and editors. The RECORDING screen is accessed by turning the encoder on the HOME screen. It allows you to **start/stop** the recording and configure its parameters. Navigation is similar to other screens: pressing the knob accesses internal navigation, and within each option, a click allows you to change its value or state. - **STATUS**\ Allows you to **enable or stop** the recording.\ When stopped, the file with the recorded content up to that point is automatically generated. - **MAX TIME**\ Defines the maximum recording time. - Prevents the operator from having to stop it manually. - The recording is automatically cut off when the defined time is reached. - Editing: the value is entered using the console's numeric keypad (maximum **240 minutes / 4 hours**). - It is possible to **increase the time limit while the recording is in progress**, without interrupting it. - **BIT RATE**\ Defines the audio quality. - Range: **64 to 320 kbps**. - The higher the value, the better the quality and the larger the file size. - At **192 kbps**, approximately **100 hours** can be stored within the console. When recording is enabled, the main screen indicates the recording status and shows the **remaining available time**. ---
sections.title: Pantalla de grabación

sections.translation:
## Recording Management

Management (monitoring, playback, renaming, downloading, and cleanup) is performed **remotely** from a networked computer.

To access: enter the equipment's IP address followed by **/recording** in a browser (Firefox, Chrome, Safari, Edge, etc.).

Example: `192.168.0.118/recording`

<Steps>
  <Step title="Connect the console">
    Connect the console to the local network using the **Ethernet** port (recommended) or the **Wi-Fi** antenna.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open the browser">
    On a computer on the same network, open a browser and enter the MX2200's **IP address** with the subpath `/recording`.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Get the IP address">
    To find the assigned IP, turn the **CONTROL (encoder)** knob and access the **SETUP** screen.\
    The first three items show the connection status and IP address for **Ethernet**, **Wi-Fi**, and **4G Modem**.
  </Step>
</Steps>

---
sections.title: Gestión de las grabaciones

sections.translation: ### Web Interface - Each \_recording \_is saved with the name: `[Unit Name] + [Date and Time]` - The **HTML5** interface includes a player for **fast-forward, rewind, and pause**. - The list can be sorted by **name, date, or size**. The displayed date corresponds to the **local time of the client computer**, not the console. - The audio can be **downloaded** and will be saved to the browser's default download folder.
